name: qa-grpc
description: gRPC testing: buf lint and breaking-change gates, ghz load tests, grpcurl, mock servers, and streaming RPC test suites. Includes the protobuf versioning catalog, interceptor test patterns, and a status-code catalog. A review agent (grpc-service-reviewer) flags missing status-code assertions and deadline handling. Distinct from qa-contract-testing/protobuf-compat-checking (schema-level breaking detection).
